title: How to get to Chamonix Mont-Blanc?
claims: Geneva airport (GVA) is approximately 1 hour 30 minutes from Chamonix, with direct bus transfers or a train from Geneva Cornavin station.
Lyon Saint-Exupéry airport (LYS) is approximately 2 hours 30 minutes away, via TGV to Annecy or Bellegarde and then train or bus.
Milan Malpensa airport (MXP) has direct bus services to Chamonix with BlaBlaCar or FlixBus.
Zurich airport (ZRH) is reached through Switzerland by train.
Paris CDG/ORY connects by direct TGV to Annecy or Bellegarde, then train or bus to Chamonix.
Saint-Gervais-les-Bains-Le Fayet station connects to the Mont-Blanc Express.
Annecy station connects to Saint-Gervais-les-Bains and the Mont-Blanc Express, or by direct shuttle.
Lyon Part-Dieu connects by shuttle with FlixBus or BlaBlaCar Bus.
The Chamonix Mobilité public transport network covers the valley from Servoz to Vallorcine.
The organiser discourages arriving by private car because city-centre car parks are saturated during the event.
